description: This file defines a mock class GstSrcMock for testing purposes, which implements the IGstSrc interface. It includes mock methods for initializing the source, setting up and adding app sources, and indicating when all app sources are added. The class is part of the firebolt::rialto::server namespace and is used in the context of media streaming and GStreamer integration.

classes.name: GstSrcMock
classes.description: A mock implementation of the IGstSrc interface for testing purposes, providing mock methods for media source initialization and setup.

methods.name: initSrc
methods.description: Mock method to initialize the source.

methods.name: setupAndAddAppArc
methods.description: Mock method to set up and add an app source with specified parameters such as decryption service, Gst element, stream info, callbacks, user data, and media source type.

methods.name: allAppSrcsAdded
methods.description: Mock method to indicate that all app sources have been added.
